correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, support function of all roots e_i−e_j maximizes upper minus lower coordinate, so a facet must have exactly two functional levels corresponding to a nonempty proper subset S; each facet is the orthogonal product of simplices Delta_S−Delta_Sc. Simplex Gram determinant s gives Euclidean a_n,s=sqrt[s(n-s)]/((s−1)!(n−s−1)!). Multiplying by binomial(n,s) yields tilted hypergeometric area law with h=(1−4(X−n/2)^2/n²)^{3/2}; 1-Eh<=3/[2(2n−1)] gives dTV<=3/(4n−5). Hypergeometric CLT yields variance n/8 vs binomial-facet n/4. Facet distance rho_s=sqrt(n/[s(n−s)]); cone decomposition plus Vandermonde yields exact volume sqrt(n)/(n−1)! binomial(2n−2,n−1). Taylor expansion using hypergeometric variance n²/[4(2n−1)] and fourth moment O(n²) gives surface 1−3/(4n), area/volume 1−5/(4n); parity r_n=2/sqrt(n)(1+O(n^-2)) yields 1−1/(4n) tangency deficit. Independent n=3,4,5,30,100 tilt and volume-cone checks, while original checker separately uses Qhull n=3–6; finite checks corroborate, not prove all n.
